rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound describing bodily appearance; pīta (yellow) + varṇa (color) + aṃga (limb/body)
sandhi-fused form keśāḥ + te; keśa (hair) with nominative plural ending fused to pronoun te
anaphoric pronoun referring to the figures being described

items.question: What bodily features and head adornment characterize the described pitṛ form?
premises: The described figures have yellow-colored limbs.
The described figures possess hair as a noted feature.
The described figures have heads bound with a cloth band.
items.inference: The pitṛ form is identified by yellow-colored limbs, hair, and heads bound with a cloth band.
uncertainties: The precise meaning of vāsīkā as a specific type of cloth or headband is not fully certain from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: They have yellow-colored limbs, hair, and their heads are bound with a cloth band.
